title: <component>.json
description: A component's record, read by rbtv.

description.description: One line that is enough to decide whether the component is relevant.

dependencies.description: Outside software the component requires but does not include, one entry per program or package.

name.description: The name its publisher gives the program or package.

install.description: The command that installs it, the same on Linux and Windows, or the address of its install page when no package manager installs it. rbtv prints it and never runs it.

command.description: The name the program has on PATH. rbtv doctor looks it up. Not with python_package.

python_package.description: The name pip installs it under. rbtv doctor looks it up in the Python that runs rbtv. Not with command.

repository.description: Optional git checkout. discovery.py loads this object; the checkout is not required to exist.

url.description: Git remote stored as origin. Must equal git remote get-url origin, including spelling. Must not start with -.

branch.description: Branch cloned and fast-forwarded. No spaces or leading dash.

requirements.description: Relative pip requirements path inside the checkout. No .. segment and no absolute path.
